task.description: Applied REQ-237's PROVENANCE marker convention (marker text, structural placement rule, single-regex greppability, YAML/table/paragraph/line unit shapes) to REQ-266's exact 13-file chunk under lib/letflow/design/ (req030-definition-store-crud.md through req048-task-completion.md). For each file, inserted the fixed literal line 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' immediately above the smallest enclosing citation unit (single line, whole paragraph, whole table, heading, or list/bullet/numbered-step item -- each getting its own marker) for every .zig source-path citation, without altering any citation text. No YAML-comment shape applied since none of these 13 files carry embedded YAML. Ran before/after grep -c '\.zig' per file to prove no citation text was added/removed, and grep -c 'PROVENANCE (historical' per file to record marker counts. Sample-diffed 5 files (req030, req031, req033, req035, req048) covering well over 10 individual citation insertions to confirm only a marker line was added above each unit with zero alteration to surrounding text. Re-ran the divergence-note grep (unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co) before and after and confirmed the two matched lines are byte-identical in text (only their line numbers shifted, as expected from inserted lines above them). Confirmed via git diff --stat that CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md, and every lib/letflow/design/ file outside this chunk's 13-file list are untouched. Committed on feature/WF02-REQ266-20260905 (commit 3d7e1319); did not push, merge, flip REQ-266's status, or open a PR -- left for ORCH after REVIEWER passes.
